risk_if_not_implemented: Without Coordinate With External Service Providers, supplier and External Service Provider (ESP) weaknesses, incidents or failures may propagate into the organization's environment unmanaged. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Alternate Processing Site
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate processing site that provides processing capability and security measures equivalent to that of the primary site.
compensating_control_1.justification: Alternate Processing Site (BCD-13) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Coordinate With External Service Providers (BCD-07.4) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Alternate Storage Site
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate storage site that stores both the assets and necessary agreements needed for the recovery of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_2.justification: Alternate Storage Site (BCD-12) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Coordinate With External Service Providers (BCD-07.4) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
